execution_evidence.log_pattern: [neg] flatSearchCutoff=-1 -> create=200 persisted=-1 / [huge] flatSearchCutoff=10000000000 -> create=200 persisted=10000000000 / DEFECT[neg] Type1_IllegalSuccess: -1 persisted verbatim
